## Featured Projects
- **ITF Taekwon-Do App**: Real-time scoring, tournament brackets, and federation management with React Native, Expo, and WebSockets.
- **Trending2Tweet**: Autonomous AI content pipeline transforming trending topics into social media posts via Python and LLM workflows.
- **Fechitat**: Minimalist event and milestone countdown mobile application with clean UX and offline storage.
- **Personal Portfolio & Blog**: Ultra-fast, accessible, content-focused Astro 5 + TailwindCSS portfolio.
